question: Obtain Fidelity Charitable's dated nonprofit EFT notices (email or archived page versions, Dec 2025 to Nov 2026): what the original EFT-only text said, when and how the 2026-07-01 date was extended, any new effective date, and whether grants to unenrolled charities will be held, cancelled or mailed as checks after the cutoff
conclusion_affected: Paper checks persistence; nonprofit enrollment as binding constraint
rationale: Live Fidelity pages (2026-11-14) say EFT is 'not currently' required and checks go to unenrolled charities; the July 1 date and the extension exist only in Chariot posts and Bogleheads extracts; Wayback and the forum were unreachable from this environment

question: Which DAF sponsors are Chariot's DAFpay OAuth or Donor Accounts design partners (sponsor-sanctioned Create Grant), and do Fidelity, DAFgiving360, Vanguard and NPT consent to the credential-based 'compatible flow', or only tolerate it?
conclusion_affected: Interoperability map; S2/S3 distribution; agent access
rationale: Chariot documents the provider API but names no live provider; Donor Accounts beta has unnamed 'design partners'; the 85%-of-market compatible flow has donors authenticating to their sponsor in the DAFpay modal, which is the access NPact §2.4 bans

question: Quantify voided, returned and cancelled DAF grants by sponsor from audited financial statements, Form 990 Schedule D and footnotes, or sponsor annual reports (grant refunds, voided checks, regranted DPN funds), and estimate a void rate per check
rationale: Fidelity and BlueGive void at 90 days and DPN voids at 90 days, but no sponsor publishes a void or reissue rate

question: Do state unclaimed-property (escheat) laws apply to voided or uncashed DAF grant checks, or does reversion to the donor's fund (Fidelity, BlueGive) or sponsor regrant (Chariot DPN) take them outside escheat? Is there any audit or enforcement history?
rationale: No sponsor or vendor document reviewed mentions escheat; published policies route voided funds back to the fund or regrant them

question: Build a cross-sponsor dataset of recommendation-to-deposit latency distributions (median and P90 by rail), extending Chariot's 34-provider one-nonprofit sample with other nonprofits' bank data, and verify Charityvest's '95% deposited within 35 days' and AssetMark's '2-day median'
rationale: The only measured distributions are vendor-published, with undisclosed samples (Chariot n=1 recipient; Charityvest; AssetMark)

question: What share of PayPal Grant Payments expire unaccepted and revert to check (NPT: 14-day acceptance window), and what share of Chariot Disbursements fall back to check after the five-business-day claim window, by sponsor?
rationale: Electronic rails still need the nonprofit to act (accept or claim); fallback-to-check rates decide whether a rail actually removes checks

question: Set up dated monitoring (quarterly text diffs) of DAF and foundation vendor terms (NPact Standard Terms, Foundant MSA, Blackbaud BSA and AI Terms, Bonterra SSA, Ren iPhi/RAC MSAs, TIFIN terms) to detect any adoption of NPact §2.4-style anti-passthrough or agent-initiation clauses

question: Do the national sponsors' donor-facing online terms of use (Fidelity Charitable, DAFgiving360, Vanguard Charitable, NPT) prohibit sharing login credentials with, or account access by, third-party aggregators such as DAFpay, and who bears liability for a fraudulent grant initiated that way?
